search_text:
若 $\Omega:\sqrt{x^2+y^2}\leq z\leq2$，则 $\iiint_\Omega(x^2+y^2)dv$ 在球面坐标系下可表示为（ ） $\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^{\pi/2}d\varphi\int_0^{2/\cos\varphi}r^4\sin^3\varphi\,dr$ $\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^{\pi/4}d\varphi\int_0^{2/\cos\varphi}r^4\sin^3\varphi\,dr$ $\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^{\pi/2}d\varphi\int_0^{\sqrt2}r^4\sin^3\varphi\,dr$ $\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^{\pi/4}d\varphi\int_0^{2/\sin\varphi}r^4\sin^3\varphi\,dr$ 原式
$$
=\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}}d\varphi\int_0^{\frac{2}{\cos\varphi}}r^4\sin^3\varphi\,dr.
$$
